body.statement: For every finite vector of sample sizes and every \(P\) compatible with \(\mathcal M_{L,\eta}\), \(\Pr_P\{\Theta_I(P)\subseteq\mathcal C_n^\theta\}\ge1-\alpha\). The guarantee holds at every rank, including zero cell counts and nonidentified laws, uses no rank selection, and the set \(\mathcal C_n^\theta\) has a terminating semialgebraic description after denominator clearing.
body.justification: This provides finite-sample coverage of every causally compatible contrast through rank transitions where Wald theory is discontinuous.
body.gap: Kaido et al. provide uniformly asymptotic calibrated projection, whereas the finite multinomial model permits an exact conservative primitive region whose deterministic projection remains valid without rank regularity.
body.consumer: Small neonatal trial networks receive honest simultaneous regions even when proxy rank is weak, deficient, or empirically unstable.
